author: Yffe
content: Kernel-checked pin at lean/Thermite/PinWhileDecShape.lean: shipped_hdec_is_not_the_pinned_shape proves a concrete instance (L1 machinery, I := (· = s0) with lo=0/n=1, μ := -lo) satisfying the SHIPPED h_dec shape (0 ≤ μ st, pre-state) while REFUTING the §4.2.2-pinned shape (0 ≤ μ st', post-state) — the shapes are semantically non-equivalent, so 'STATEMENT SHAPE is the §4.2.2 sketch verbatim' (REQ-11.3 SHIPPED row) is false. Direction-safety also kernel-checked: design_hdec_implies_shipped_hdec + loopDenote_exits_of_dec_design_shape derive the design's verbatim theorem from the shipped one — the drift weakens the hypothesis (strengthens the theorem), a record-fidelity divergence, NOT a soundness hole. Generator must reconcile: either amend the §4.2.2 sketch to the shipped shape declaring the adaptation (as prefix→prefixB was declared), or restate the theorem to the pinned shape. Axioms of the pin: [propext, Quot.sound].
